description: This file implements a Flutter widget for an audiobook player screen, managing playback, progress display, and user interactions.

classes.name: PlayerScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the audiobook player screen, including controls, progress bar, and cover image.

classes.name: _PlayerScreenState
classes.description: State class managing timer, widget build, and user interactions for PlayerScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, sets the current book in provider, and starts the ticking timer.

methods.name: _maybeStartTick
methods.description: Starts or cancels the periodic timer based on whether the audiobook is playing.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer to prevent resource leaks.

methods.name: _buildCover
methods.description: Returns a widget displaying the cover image with rounded corners.

methods.name: _buildProgressBar
methods.description: Builds a slider to show and control the current playback position along with time labels.

methods.name: _formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a Duration object into a string with HH:MM:SS or MM:SS format.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the overall widget tree for the player screen, including app bar, cover, title, author, controls, and progress bar.
